fields.description: Highest stage reached, 1-based (game stage index + 1). Load path restores game stage as value - 1; store path writes game stage + 1.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801d8ac restores game struct +0x62 to save_word0 - 1 (save offset 0x100) and FUN_0801f0bc stores game struct +0x62 + 1 before the FUN_0801f270/FUN_0801d97c EEPROM write chain; +0x62 is the stage selector switched on in FUN_08007e14.
fields.name: stage_reached

fields.description: Opaque gameplay record bytes copied whole between RAM and EEPROM; all zero in a fresh save.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801d97c copies the full 16-byte RAM record to EEPROM blocks 0x20-0x21 and FUN_0801d8ac copies EEPROM blocks back to RAM opaquely via FUN_0806bc34/FUN_0806bce4; covered by the FUN_0801f29c/FUN_0801f244 checksum.
fields.name: record_data_main

fields.description: Wear-level generation counter: bumped on every advance-load, low bit selects which EEPROM slot pair is written, newest mirror wins when counters differ by less than 0x40.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801d8ac increments record halfword at +0x0C and picks the mirror with (new - old) & 0xffff < 0x40; FUN_0801f270 passes byte(+0x0C) & 1 as the slot index to FUN_0801d97c which writes EEPROM blocks 0x20 + slot * 2.
fields.name: save_generation

fields.description: Mirror copy of stage_reached in backup slot B (EEPROM blocks 0x22-0x23); blank (0xFFFF) until the first slot rotation.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801d8ac reads slot B via FUN_0806bc34 blocks ((param & 0xff) + 0x20) = 0x22 and validates it with FUN_0801f244 exactly like slot A.
fields.name: stage_reached_mirror

fields.description: Mirror copy of the opaque gameplay record bytes in backup slot B.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801d8ac loads 16 bytes from EEPROM blocks 0x22-0x23 into the same RAM record layout as slot A and validates with FUN_0801f244.
fields.name: record_data_mirror

fields.description: Mirror copy of the generation counter in backup slot B; compared against the main counter to select the newest save.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801d8ac freshness compare (new - old) & 0xffff < 0x40 across the two FUN_0806bc34 mirrors at blocks 0x20 and 0x22.
fields.name: save_generation_mirror
